I built the Mesh logo sting as a 6 s composition at 1920×1080. I checked it on a contact sheet: the animation reads correctly and it ends on the clean lockup. I did not run the critic and I did not propose a storyboard first, since your brief already fixed the concept.

- **Look:** a warm off-white background (#F7F5F0). The single accent is indigo (#5B4BFF) for the mark. The wordmark is dark ink (#1F2430), set in Inter Bold.
- **Mark:** five dots and six thin links, all drawn from shapes. The larger hub dot (**Dot 4 hub**) is the centre of the network.
- **Motion:** the hub pops in first, then the other four dots follow with a bouncy overshoot (0.15–1.1 s). The six links then draw themselves between the dots, one after another (0.7–1.7 s).
- **Wordmark:** **Wordmark** slides out from the left and fades in at 1.7–2.4 s. It uses an Expo Out ease.
- **Hold:** the lockup is still from about 2.4 s to the end of the 6 s.

The five dots and six links are separate layers, so you can retime or restyle them one by one. I can also add a small pulse through the network just before the wordmark, or make a dark-theme version.
